plain_english: Outpatient doctor consultation fee for a specialist or super-specialist.
billing_alert: Private hospitals often charge ₹1,000 to ₹2,500. Under CGHS empanelment, ceiling is ₹350.

procedure_name: Consultation Inpatient (IPD) - Daily visit by Specialist
plain_english: Doctor's daily bedside visit while admitted in the hospital.
billing_alert: Watch out for multiple doctors billing daily visits on the same bill without documented consultation notes.

procedure_name: ICU Bed Charges (Per Day, including Monitoring & Nursing)
plain_english: Intensive Care Unit (ICU/ICCU) room rent per day.
billing_alert: CGHS ICU rate is ALL-INCLUSIVE of monitor, nursing charges, and duty doctor charges. Private hospitals unbundle and charge nursing + monitor separately.

plain_english: Standard shared room or general ward bed charge per day.
billing_alert: Check for IRDAI proportionate deduction if your insurance policy has a 1% room rent cap.

plain_english: Twin-sharing room hospital bed charge per day.
billing_alert: Nursing and RMO charges must not exceed standard tariff limits.

procedure_name: Complete Blood Count (CBC / Hemogram with ESR)
plain_english: Standard blood test measuring hemoglobin, TLC, DLC, platelets, and ESR.
billing_alert: Private hospital in-house labs often charge 3x to 5x of the CGHS/NABL ceiling.

plain_english: Blood test checking heart health and cholesterol levels.
billing_alert: Often billed at ₹1,000+ in private hospital packages.

procedure_name: Liver Function Test (LFT) / Bilirubin, SGOT, SGPT, Alk Phos
plain_english: Diagnostic panel evaluating liver health and enzyme levels.
billing_alert: Individual enzymes are sometimes unbundled and billed separately.

procedure_name: Kidney Function Test (KFT) / Renal Profile (Urea, Creatinine, Electrolytes)
plain_english: Blood test measuring kidney performance and electrolytes.
billing_alert: Essential baseline lab test.

plain_english: 3-month average blood glucose test for diabetes management.
billing_alert: Standard outpatient test.

plain_english: Standard chest X-ray.
billing_alert: Digital X-Ray film charges are legally included in this fee.

plain_english: Abdominal sonography scan.
billing_alert: Private hospitals often bill Upper Abdomen and Pelvis separately (unbundling).

plain_english: Computed Tomography brain scan without contrast dye.
billing_alert: Hospitals frequently inflate CT scan charges for emergency trauma admissions.

procedure_name: MRI Brain / Knee / Spine (Plain without Contrast)
plain_english: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scan of brain, knee, or lumbar spine.
billing_alert: Private hospitals often charge ₹8,000 to ₹14,000, nearly 4x the CGHS benchmark.

plain_english: Kidney dialysis session for removing toxins from the blood.
billing_alert: CGHS rate includes dialyzer tubing and standard anticoagulant medication.

plain_english: Standard childbirth delivery package including labor room and obstetrician fees.
billing_alert: Check for separate charges for baby pediatric assessment and nursery.

plain_english: Surgical birth delivery package.
billing_alert: Package should cover OT charges, surgeon fee, and standard post-op stay.

procedure_name: Cataract Surgery with Foldable IOL (Phacoemulsification, Single Eye)
plain_english: Eye lens replacement surgery for cataract removal.
billing_alert: The CGHS package covers the surgery and standard hydrophilic/hydrophobic lens. Premium toric/multifocal lenses have additional approved copays.

plain_english: Keyhole surgery to remove infected or stone-filled gallbladder.
billing_alert: Private hospitals often charge consumables, trocars, and harmonic scalpel tips separately.

plain_english: Diagnostic catheter test checking blood flow through heart arteries.
billing_alert: Contrast dye and catheter charges are included in standard packages.

procedure_name: Coronary Angioplasty (PTCA with 1 Drug-Eluting Stent, Package)
plain_english: Heart stent insertion to open blocked cardiac blood vessels.
billing_alert: NPPA (National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority) legally caps DES stents at approx ₹38,000 + GST. Hospitals cannot charge more for the stent itself.

procedure_name: Coronary Artery Bypass Graft (CABG / Open Heart Bypass Surgery)
plain_english: Heart bypass surgery for severe multi-vessel blockages.
billing_alert: Package includes pre-op workup, surgical team fees, ICU care (up to 3 days), and ward stay.

procedure_name: Total Knee Replacement (TKR - Unilateral, Single Knee)
plain_english: Knee joint replacement surgery using a titanium/cobalt-chromium implant.
billing_alert: Implant prices are strictly capped by NPPA. Verify that the hospital does not inflate implant costs under separate consumable heads.
